result.rationale: The diff's poll_feed.rb calls `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` with no nil guard. In RSS 2.0 items the standard element is `description`, not `content` (SimpleRSS only defines `content` for Atom/`content:encoded`), so description-only feeds would yield nil and raise NoMethodError; combined with `sidekiq_options retry: false` in the same new job, the failure is silent. The mechanism is plausible and grounded in diff code, though SimpleRSS's exact behavior isn't fully verifiable from the diff alone.

judged_text: poll_feed dereferences i.content with no nil guard, but items in description-only RSS 2.0 feeds — the format the feed_polling_url setting explicitly advertises — have no content element, so SimpleRSS yields nil and the poll crashes with NoMethodError. The hourly poll dies before importing anything, and because the job declares sidekiq_options retry: false the exception is discarded silently, so feed importing stops with no error surfaced to the operator.
